item.text: {"summary":"Draft is methodologically usable, but it is not publishable because the resolver fields override the canonical ledger contract.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"resolver","severity":"blocking","summary":"The draft sets resolutionDate to 2026-08-27 and uses DOL data.pdf as the resolution URL, but the canonical ledger contract requires resolutionDate 2026-09-02 and the ALFRED graph CSV source binding for ICSA.","actionRequested":"Set resolutionDate to \"2026-09-02\", set the resolution source/URL to the registered ALFRED ICSA binding, and keep the DOL 2026-08-27 schedule discrepancy only in reasoning rather than in contract fields."},{"rubricItem":"coherence","severity":"blocking","summary":"The JSON fields conflict with the target contract even though the reasoning says the target should remain tied to the registered slug and dataPointId.","actionRequested":"Make the top-level resolver fields byte-consistent with the ledger target while preserving the same point, interval, unit, slug, and dataPointId if otherwise unchanged."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Clarify that DOL is the substantive first-print source and ALFRED is the registered resolution adapter/mirror.","Use \"ET\" rather than \"EST\" for the August release-time statement unless quoting a source exactly."]}
